mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_file_status (file_path, file_name, data_type, file_type, analysis_date, subbarcode, product_bio, file_size, status, create_by, create_time, analysis_id, del_flag) VALUES (#{row.filePath}, #{row.fileName}, #{row.dataType}, #{row.fileType}, #{row.analysisDate}, #{row.subbarcode}, #{row.productBio}, #{row.fileSize}, #{row.status}, #{row.createBy}, NOW(), #{row.analysisId}, '0')
mapper.select: SELECT file_id FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND file_name = #{fileName} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY file_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_path AS filePath, file_name AS fileName, file_type AS fileType, status AS status FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND file_id = #{fileId} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_file_status SET del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND file_name = #{fileName} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE analysis_file_status SET status = 'Loaded', mut_num = #{mutNum}, file_text = #{fileText}, message = NULL, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: SELECT file_id AS fileId, file_name AS fileName, file_type AS fileType, status, mut_num AS mutNum, message FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY file_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_file_status WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND del_flag = '0' AND status = 'Loaded'
